meta.name: fix-what-i-pointed-at
meta.description: Pick up the bugs a human flagged by pointing at them in the running app, each arriving with the element, the note they typed, and the source file and line. Use when the user says they marked or flagged something, when starting a session on an app someone has been clicking through, when a designer or PM has left feedback in the UI, or when the user describes a problem as "that button there" without saying which file.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 指着界面上的毛病,就能拿到对应的源码文件和行号去修
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果有人在运行中的页面上标了问题却说不清是哪个文件
copy.tagline_en: Point at a glitch in the running app and get the exact source file and line to fix
copy.fit_line_en: For you if teammates flag issues in the live UI but can't say which file to open

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会读取你在运行中的应用里点选标记的 bug(带元素、你写的备注和 file:line),打开对应源码修好,在应用里验证后再把该标记标记为已解决。
howto.when: 当你提到自己标记(flag)了某处、会话开始前有人点过这个应用、或你只说“那个按钮那里”而没给出文件名时触发。

say.text: 我在应用里标了一个 bug,读一下标记然后修掉
say.note: 会列出标记并给出 file:line

say.text: 把标记 m1 修好后在应用里验证,再 resolve 掉
say.note: 修复、验证、解决一条标记

say.text: 这条标记我不打算修,说明原因并保持未解决
say.note: 标记保持打开,不会被悄悄丢掉

howto.what_en: Claude reads the bug marks a human left by pointing at elements in the running app — each with the element, their note, and file:line — opens the source, fixes it, verifies in the app, then resolves the mark.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says they flagged or marked something, when a session starts on an app someone has been clicking through, or when they point at "that button there" without naming a file.

say_en.text: I flagged a bug in the app — read the marks and fix it.
Fix mark m1, verify it in the app, then resolve it.
I'm not fixing this one — say why and leave it unresolved.
